description: Fetch and extract text content from any public URL - PDF documents, web pages, articles, docs. Returns the extracted text, word count, and a summary. Works on research papers, contracts, articles, reports. Use when user says 'read this PDF', 'extract from this URL', 'summarize this document', 'what does this say'.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

max_chars.description: Max characters of raw text to return (default: 4000, max: 8000).

summarize.description: Also generate an AI summary. Default: true.

url.description: Public URL to the document or webpage to extract and summarize.

name: pdf_extract
title: PDF Extract
